title: Selected public research milestones and compact archive index
scope: Public academic decision summaries, not verbatim chat transcripts or hidden AI reasoning. Dates are from known conversation dates or repository author dates. No July record was available; no events have been invented for that period.

snapshot.retention: Files removed only from the current tree. Git history is not rewritten; each file remains addressable at the snapshot. No new private conversation material or credentials are included.

milestones.decision_summary: Repository records the first verifiable import; no July conversation entry is asserted.
Study Lie group methods for nonlinear PDEs before learning. Use shallow-water and bed coupling as a concrete test; distinguish an exact reduction from approximation.
User asked how parameter changes and PDE structure affect the reduction, series solution and eventual symmetry-aware learning; no claim of arbitrary PDE solvability.
milestones.source: Selected visible project conversation / delivery research path

milestones.decision_summary: Keep negative neural results and prioritize the mathematical obstruction near the cubic exponent rather than optimize an unverified solver.
User requested primary texts by Olver and Oliveri and complete explanations of coordinate transformations, vector fields and symmetry reduction.
Separate printed scalar from compatible material equation; reproduce published formulae and distinguish verified identities from source errata.
User emphasized characteristic equations, prolongation, jet-coordinate splitting and quotient maps. Preserve the equation (27) calculation and its references.
Do not interpret sampled residual alone as field accuracy; separate solver controls and use reproducible verification.
User requested a branch comparison distinguishing proved, verified, proposed and unresolved statements; preserve strict failing controls rather than assert a general solver.
Retain local material reconstruction, convergent pole branch and annular crossing theorem with their hypotheses.
User required a deterministic SymPy script with symbolic m >= 1, explicit ansatz boundaries, clear inputs and outputs; independent Klausen replay was a historical related-work test.
Prefer fixed-point defect bounds where an invariant contraction is established. Keep sampled diagnostics distinct from continuous certificates; ML is optional.
milestones.source: Selected visible project conversation / delivery research path

milestones.decision_summary: User requested parameter-to-symmetry-algebra mapping, conditional solvability tests, first-integral elimination, a six-minute defense and a concise thesis. Arbitrary flux group classification remains future work.
milestones.source: Selected visible project conversation / delivery research path

milestones.decision_summary: Reduce symbolically before approximation; distinguish parameter rank changes from singular reduced profiles, state analytic existence conditions, use physical reconstruction; report learning as not better than the classical method.
milestones.source: Selected visible project conversation / delivery research path

milestones.decision_summary: User requests compact history, portable rendering, literature acquisition, a standard installable reducer, and moving historical experiments outside the main workflow; this public release uses authorized literature sources.
milestones.source: Selected visible project conversation / delivery research path
